subject: Agriculture
title: Lab-Grown Meat
description: A fast breakdown of Lab-Grown Meat for builders.

hook.text: The first lab-grown burger cost $330,000 in 2013. By 2023, it dropped to around $10. The price keeps falling.

buildup.text: Cultured meat grows animal cells in bioreactors fed with nutrients—real meat without raising or slaughtering animals.

discovery.text: Singapore approved cultivated chicken for sale in 2020—the first country to allow commercial cell-cultured meat.

twist.text: Scaling remains the challenge. Bioreactors big enough for mass production don't exist yet—the industry needs pharma-scale tanks.

climax.text: If scaled, lab meat could reduce agriculture's land use by 95% and greenhouse gas emissions by 78–96%.

punchline.text: Real meat, no animal. The factory is a bioreactor. The future is brewing.

quiz.question: Which country first approved commercial sale of lab-grown meat?
